sources.title: Overview of the Blue Gene/L system architecture
sources.titleEn: Overview of the Blue Gene/L system architecture
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Mira Blue Gene/Q：多執行緒與有效算術吞吐
related.titleEn: Mira Blue Gene/Q: hardware threads and useful arithmetic
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩核心時間線、同步門檻與角色配置表；52、68、84與44門檻可重算，無重複或遺漏工作ID；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver dual-core timelines, synchronization threshold and role allocation. Reproduce 52, 68, 84 and break-even 44 with no repeated or missing job IDs. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 建立核心、硬體執行緒、軟體工作三層表；同核心上的執行緒共用資源；0.8與0.6重現且工作960不變；若答案誤差超教學1e−10即拒絕較快方案。
related.differenceEn: Map cores, hardware threads and software tasks in separate layers; threads on one core share resources. Reproduce 0.8 and 0.6 for fixed 960 work; reject the faster option if teaching error exceeds1e−10.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學方案A以兩核心分攤W並付同步h，T=W/2+h；方案B一核心計算、另一服務，T=W+c；固定W=80毫秒，方案A h=12；改h=28，資料及計算量不變。方案B c=4；名義式 80/2+12 = 52 ms；變更式 80/2+28 = 68 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
固定工作F的時間T=F/R，R是已量測的有效吞吐；不能以硬體執行緒倍數直接乘峰值；合成F=960百萬FLOP，一模式R=1200 MFLOP/s，另一模式R=1600；不含啟動；名義式 960/1200 = 0.8 s；變更式 960/1600 = 0.6 s。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching option A splits W across two cores plus synchronization h; option B uses one compute core and one service core, T=W+c. W=80 ms, option A h=12 then 28 with identical data/work; option B c=4. Nominal 80/2+12 = 52 ms; changed 80/2+28 = 68 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For fixed work F, time T=F/R uses measured useful throughput, not a hardware-thread multiplier on peak. Synthetic F=960 million FLOP; useful rates 1200 and 1600 MFLOP/s, excluding startup. Nominal 960/1200 = 0.8 s; changed 960/1600 = 0.6 s. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: El Capitan MI300A：共享記憶體與資料重用
related.titleEn: El Capitan MI300A: shared memory and reuse accounting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩核心時間線、同步門檻與角色配置表；52、68、84與44門檻可重算，無重複或遺漏工作ID；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver dual-core timelines, synchronization threshold and role allocation. Reproduce 52, 68, 84 and break-even 44 with no repeated or missing job IDs. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫CPU準備、GPU讀取及CPU消費的同一資料物件，分別標位址一致、可見性與快取流量；40/20毫秒下限重現，資料版本一致，流量與延遲證據分開。
related.differenceEn: Trace one object through CPU preparation, GPU reads and CPU consumption, separating address identity, visibility and traffic. Reproduce 40/20 ms bounds, match versions and separate traffic evidence from latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 教學方案A以兩核心分攤W並付同步h，T=W/2+h；方案B一核心計算、另一服務，T=W+c；固定W=80毫秒，方案A h=12；改h=28，資料及計算量不變。方案B c=4；名義式 80/2+12 = 52 ms；變更式 80/2+28 = 68 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
讀取B bytes、有效頻寬b bytes/s時理想下限T=B/b；快取重用可減少B但需實際證據；合成B=24GB、b=600GB/s；重用後只讀12GB，使用十進位GB；名義式 24/600 = 0.04 s；變更式 12/600 = 0.02 s。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Teaching option A splits W across two cores plus synchronization h; option B uses one compute core and one service core, T=W+c. W=80 ms, option A h=12 then 28 with identical data/work; option B c=4. Nominal 80/2+12 = 52 ms; changed 80/2+28 = 68 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Reading B bytes at effective bandwidth b gives lower bound T=B/b; cache reuse may reduce B but needs evidence. Synthetic B 24 GB, b 600 GB/s; reuse reduces reads to 12 GB, decimal GB. Nominal 24/600 = 0.04 s; changed 12/600 = 0.02 s. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
